# PhysioDevices

[![r-universe](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev/badges/PhysioDevices)](https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev/PhysioDevices)
[![License:
MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/LICENSE)

`PhysioDevices` imports exports from supported wearable and laboratory
systems into `PhysioExperiment` or `MultiRatePhysioExperiment` objects.
Native sampling rates, device metadata, events, and import provenance
are retained where the source format provides them.

## Installation

``` r

options(repos = c(
  xbiosignal = "https://x-biosignal.r-universe.dev",
  CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"
))
install.packages("PhysioDevices")
```

## Quick start

The package includes a small Empatica E4 fixture:

``` r

library(PhysioDevices)

session <- system.file("extdata", "e4_sample", package = "PhysioDevices")
recording <- readEmpaticaE4(session)

PhysioCore::streamNames(recording)
```

## Supported readers

| Source | Reader | Result |
|----|----|----|
| Empatica E4 CSV session | [`readEmpaticaE4()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readEmpaticaE4.md) | Multi-rate recording |
| Empatica EmbracePlus Avro | [`readEmbracePlusAvro()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readEmbracePlusAvro.md) | Multi-rate recording |
| Shimmer Consensys export | [`readShimmer()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readShimmer.md) | Multi-rate recording |
| Polar HR/RR export | [`readPolar()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readPolar.md) | Recording with beat events |
| BIOPAC AcqKnowledge | [`readBIOPAC()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readBIOPAC.md) | Multi-rate recording |
| Delsys Trigno | [`readDelsysTrigno()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readDelsysTrigno.md) | Multi-rate EMG/IMU recording |
| Xsens MVNX | [`readXsensMVNX()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readXsensMVNX.md) | Motion-capture recording |

EmbracePlus and BIOPAC readers expose
[`hasAvroBackend()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/hasAvroBackend.md)
and
[`hasBioread()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/hasBioread.md)
so applications can check optional backends before importing.

## Ecosystem role

`PhysioDevices` is an acquisition adapter. Its outputs use the common
`PhysioCore` model and can move into preprocessing, modality-specific
analysis, cross-modal synchronization, or streaming workflows without a
device-specific container.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`hasAvroBackend()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/hasAvroBackend.md)
  : Is an Avro backend available?
- [`hasBioread()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/hasBioread.md)
  : Is a BIOPAC (bioread) backend available?
- [`readBIOPAC()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readBIOPAC.md)
  : Read a BIOPAC AcqKnowledge (.acq) file
- [`readDelsysTrigno()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readDelsysTrigno.md)
  : Read a Delsys Trigno CSV export
- [`readEmbracePlusAvro()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readEmbracePlusAvro.md)
  : Read an Empatica EmbracePlus Avro container
- [`readEmpaticaE4()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readEmpaticaE4.md)
  : Read an Empatica E4 CSV session directory
- [`readPolar()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readPolar.md)
  : Read a Polar heart-rate / R-R interval export
- [`readShimmer()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readShimmer.md)
  : Read a Shimmer GSR3+ Consensys CSV export
- [`readXsensMVNX()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioDevices/reference/readXsensMVNX.md)
  : Read an Xsens MVNX motion-capture export
